name: The Ascendant's Champion
description: Raise an agent to Aspect tier. Elevate a mortal to divine status.

conditions.description: At least 1 worshipper at tier 2 (Demigod) or higher

stages.description: Elevate 1 agent to Divine tier (tier 3) AND have 3 agents at Demigod tier.

conditions.description: At least 1 worshipper at tier 3 (Divine) or higher
At least 3 worshippers at tier 2 (Demigod) or higher

stages.description: Elevate 1 agent to Aspect tier (tier 4), cementing their immortality.

prose.setup_to_escalation: One mortal rises beyond the veil. Demigod now, they bear your mark. The world begins to see that divinity can be granted.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: One ascends to true divinity while three demigodsstand as proof of your power. Your champions multiply. The age of mortals is ending.
prose.completed: Aspect tier is achieved. One of your champions now sits among the eternal. They are your eternal voice in the world. Immortality given and received.
prose.failed: Your chosen ones fall back to lesser stations. Elevation slips through your fingers. Perhaps mortals were never meant to touch the divine.
